The code review is clean. The PR conflicts with current main. Refresh the branch before merge.

The Z refusal stays in both checks. Both checks use the same reason. The cycle clause appears only for a section with a cycle.
Issue #2474 permits a clearer refusal with a recorded decision. This PR uses that option.

Results ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2785`. No GitHub runner ran.
The tested tree includes a trial merge with main `e042e32f8`. The PR head stayed unchanged during the review.
Main advanced to `744c0847b04d54cfc6e3e8b24a21520c40b6bcef` during validation. A second trial merge confirms the conflict.
The results below apply to the first trial merge. They do not validate a conflict resolution.

Quick gate: `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed all 8 steps.

| Suite | Passed | Ignored |
|---|---:|---:|
| post lib | 76 | 0 |
| post wcs_flip | 16 | 0 |
| post wcs_flip_dialects | 9 | 0 |
| app lib | 390 | 1 |
| app wcs_flip | 7 | 0 |
| app wcs_flip_post | 10 | 0 |

`cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.
The builds used an empty `RUSTC_WRAPPER` and `CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE=1`.

Safety checks and mutations:

- Force the cycle clause with `if true`: `a_flipped_z_without_a_cycle_names_the_tool_length_word_only` failed as expected. Restored code passed.
- Restore the old app refusal: `a_flipped_z_refuses_the_post_by_name` failed as expected. Restored code passed.
- No golden changed. No posted program file changed. No UI file changed, so screenshots are not required.

Extra suites run:

- Neither extra-suite rule applies. The diff changes no fixture directory, test data, or importer code.
- The required heavy gate also ran locally. `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` passed all 183 steps in 21.8 minutes.
- The heavy tests had 42 passes. The registered #1950 test failed at its expected assertion. The gate confirmed that expected failure.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/post/src/post/wcs_flip.rs:18`: merge current main into the branch. Resolve the conflict in the module documentation. Keep the new Z reason and the rotation support from main. Run the gates again on the resolved tree.

No other blocking finding was found. The review label is `conflicts`. The PR stays a draft.
